Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the very first step by failing to properly disambiguate the subject "William W. Blair." The search results clearly indicated two different individuals: William Wallace Blair (1828–1896), an RLDS Church apostle born in Holley, New York, and William W. Blair (1831–1903), a different person born in Chatham, Ontario, Canada. The Planner incorrectly assumed the RLDS figure was the intended subject without verifying if there was a more prominent "William W. Blair" (such as William W. Blair, the 18th-century American politician from Pennsylvania, who is often the default referent for this name in general knowledge contexts). By locking onto the RLDS figure based on a weak match of initials and ignoring the potential for a more famous or contextually appropriate figure (or the Canadian figure), the Planner set the entire reasoning process on the wrong track, leading to the incorrect conclusion of "Orleans County, New York."
